scope: Repository-owned defocusing semilinear wave on R x T3 with principal-series Hilbert target; not the GU interaction or a constrained gauge theory.

interaction.sobolev_control: H1(T3;H_ps) embeds in L6, so the cubic maps H1 locally Lipschitzly to L2
interaction.well_posedness: energy-subcritical local well-posedness plus coercive conserved defocusing energy gives global finite-energy evolution
interaction.causality: the pointwise spacetime nonlinearity preserves finite propagation speed
interaction.internal_equivariance: N(Uu)=U N(u) for every unitary U on H_ps

claim_ceiling: The principal-series Hilbert carrier admits a local defocusing nonlinear wave with positive coercive energy, global finite-energy evolution, finite propagation and internal-unitary equivariance. This interaction is repository-selected, unconstrained and not the GU action.
